counterfactual_fixtures.purpose: adds a non-qualifying or boundary row

reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id FROM warehouses w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_snapshots i WHERE i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.on_hand_qty=0) ORDER BY w.warehouse_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id FROM warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.on_hand_qty=0 GROUP BY w.warehouse_id HAVING COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=0 ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
